blocks.en: Method Suitability and Neutralization

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 Table 1 中五種標準測試微生物的培養條件、適用培養基及計數方法對應關係
blocks.en: Understand the culture conditions, applicable media and enumeration methods for the five standard test microorganisms in Table 1

blocks.zh: 理解培養基生長促進試驗的判斷標準（factor of 2 rule）
blocks.en: Understand the acceptance criterion for growth promotion of the media (the factor of 2 rule)

blocks.zh: 學會根據產品特性選擇正確的樣品前處理方法（水溶性、非脂肪不溶性、脂肪性、氣霧劑、經皮貼片）
blocks.en: Learn to choose the correct sample preparation method for the product type (water-soluble, non-fatty insoluble, fatty, aerosol, transdermal patch)

blocks.zh: 熟悉 Table 2 中常見干擾物質與對應中和劑的配對關係
blocks.en: Become familiar with how the interfering substances in Table 2 pair with their neutralizing agents

blocks.zh: 理解三種微生物回收方法（薄膜過濾法、平板計數法、MPN 法）的詳細操作
blocks.en: Understand in detail the three methods for recovering microorganisms (membrane filtration, plate-count methods, MPN method)

blocks.zh: 能夠解讀 Table 3（MPN 值表）並正確報告結果
blocks.en: Be able to read Table 3 (MPN values) and report results correctly

blocks.zh: 1.1 Growth Promotion of the Media & Table 1: Test Microorganisms — 培養基生長促進試驗與測試微生物
blocks.en: 1.1 Growth Promotion of the Media & Table 1: Test Microorganisms

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 五種標準測試微生物的選擇邏輯：
blocks.en: Why these five standard test microorganisms:

blocks.zh: S. aureus（金黃色葡萄球菌）：革蘭氏陽性球菌代表，常見環境污染菌，也是皮膚常在菌
blocks.en: S. aureus (Staphylococcus aureus): representative Gram-positive coccus; a common environmental contaminant and a normal skin colonizer

blocks.zh: P. aeruginosa（綠膿桿菌）：革蘭氏陰性桿菌代表，水系統常見菌，機會性致病菌
blocks.en: P. aeruginosa (Pseudomonas aeruginosa): representative Gram-negative rod; common in water systems; an opportunistic pathogen

blocks.zh: B. subtilis（枯草桿菌）：孢子形成菌代表，抵抗力強，常用於滅菌/消毒效能驗證
blocks.en: B. subtilis (Bacillus subtilis): representative spore former; highly resistant, often used to verify sterilization/disinfection efficacy

blocks.zh: C. albicans（白色念珠菌）：酵母菌代表，人體常在菌
blocks.en: C. albicans (Candida albicans): representative yeast; a normal human commensal

blocks.zh: A. brasiliensis（巴西麴菌）：黴菌代表，產孢子，環境中常見
blocks.en: A. brasiliensis (Aspergillus brasiliensis): representative mold; spore-forming and common in the environment

blocks.zh: 這五種涵蓋了 G(+)、G(-)、孢子形成菌、酵母菌、黴菌 — 代表了最常見的微生物類群。
blocks.en: Together, these five cover Gram-positive bacteria, Gram-negative bacteria, spore formers, yeasts and molds, which represent the most common groups of microorganisms.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 「Factor of 2」規則就像品管公差：
blocks.en: The "factor of 2" rule is like a quality control tolerance:

blocks.zh: 如果你接種了 80 cfu 到培養基上，期望長出 80 個菌落。USP 要求實際計數不得偏離超過 2 倍 — 也就是說，計數結果需在 40–160 的範圍內（80 ÷ 2 = 40，80 × 2 = 160）。
blocks.en: If you inoculate 80 cfu onto the medium, you expect 80 colonies. USP requires that the actual count not deviate by more than a factor of 2, so the count must fall within 40–160 (80 ÷ 2 = 40, 80 × 2 = 160).

blocks.zh: 這就像製造業的公差概念：零件尺寸可以有一定的偏差，但不能超過規定範圍。培養基的「尺寸」就是它支持微生物生長的能力。
blocks.en: This is like the tolerance concept in manufacturing: a part's dimensions may vary somewhat, but not beyond the specified range. For a medium, the "dimension" is its ability to support microbial growth.

blocks.zh: 計算說明 Factor of 2 Rule
blocks.en: Calculation: Factor of 2 Rule

blocks.zh: 固體培養基生長促進判斷：
blocks.en: Growth promotion criterion for solid media:

blocks.zh:
接種量 = N cfu（標準化接種液）
實際計數 = C cfu

合格條件：N/2 ≤ C ≤ N×2

範例：接種 50 cfu
  合格範圍 = 25 ~ 100 cfu
  計數 = 45 cfu → 合格
  計數 = 120 cfu → 不合格（超過 2 倍）
blocks.en:
Inoculum = N cfu (standardized inoculum suspension)
Actual count = C cfu

Acceptance criterion: N/2 ≤ C ≤ N×2

Example: inoculum of 50 cfu
  Acceptable range = 25 to 100 cfu
  Count = 45 cfu → pass
  Count = 120 cfu → fail (more than 2 times the inoculum)

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: TYMC 培養基上的特殊安排：注意三種細菌（S. aureus、P. aeruginosa、B. subtilis）不用於 TYMC 的生長促進或適用性測試。這是因為 TYMC 使用 SDA 培養基在 20–25°C 培養，主要針對黴菌和酵母菌。
blocks.en: Special arrangement for TYMC media: note that the three bacteria (S. aureus, P. aeruginosa, B. subtilis) are not used for growth promotion or suitability testing for TYMC. This is because TYMC uses SDA incubated at 20–25°C, which targets mainly molds and yeasts.

blocks.zh: MPN 法不適用於黴菌：Table 1 標註 C. albicans 和 A. brasiliensis 的 MPN 為「not applicable」。因為黴菌的生長型態（菌絲蔓延）使得 MPN 法的「有/無生長」判斷極不可靠。
blocks.en: The MPN method is not applicable to molds: Table 1 marks the MPN method as "not applicable" for C. albicans and A. brasiliensis. The growth pattern of molds (spreading hyphae) makes the growth/no-growth reading used in the MPN method highly unreliable.

blocks.zh: 菌懸液保存期限：室溫下使用須在 2 小時內；2–8°C 冷藏可延長至 24 小時。超過時間則菌量可能下降，影響測試準確性。
blocks.en: Holding time of microbial suspensions: use within 2 hours at room temperature; storage at 2–8°C extends this to 24 hours. Beyond that, the microbial count may decline and affect test accuracy.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 選擇 A. brasiliensis 而不是 Aspergillus niger 作為黴菌代表？（提示：分類學更新）
blocks.en: Why did USP choose A. brasiliensis rather than Aspergillus niger as the representative mold? (Hint: taxonomic update)

blocks.zh: 如果一批 SCDA 的 P. aeruginosa 生長促進結果為接種 70 cfu，回收計數 30 cfu，這批培養基能用嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: For a batch of SCDA, the growth promotion result for P. aeruginosa is an inoculum of 70 cfu and a recovered count of 30 cfu. Can the batch be used? Why?

blocks.zh: 1.2 Preparation of the Sample — 樣品前處理
blocks.en: 1.2 Preparation of the Sample

blocks.zh: 做血液檢查前的「抽血」技術：
blocks.en: Like choosing the right tube for a blood draw:

blocks.zh: 樣品前處理就像醫院抽血 — 針對不同的檢查項目，需要用不同顏色的真空管（不同的抗凝劑/添加劑）。如果用錯了管子，檢驗結果就不可靠。同樣地，脂肪性產品用水性稀釋液溶不開，你就得換「專用管子」（isopropyl myristate 或 polysorbate 80）。
blocks.en: Sample preparation is like drawing blood at a hospital: different tests need different colored vacuum tubes (different anticoagulants/additives). Use the wrong tube and the result is unreliable. Likewise, a fatty product will not dissolve in an aqueous diluent, so you need a "special tube" (isopropyl myristate or polysorbate 80).

blocks.zh: 1:10 稀釋是預設值：原文多次提到「usually a 1 in 10 dilution」。這意味著 1 g（或 1 mL）的產品溶於/懸浮於 9 mL 的稀釋液中。這個稀釋度是方法適用性驗證的起點 — 如果 1:10 仍有抑菌性，需要進一步稀釋。
blocks.en: A 1 in 10 dilution is the default: the original text repeatedly says "usually a 1 in 10 dilution". This means 1 g (or 1 mL) of product dissolved/suspended in 9 mL of diluent. This dilution is the starting point for method suitability; if a 1:10 dilution is still antimicrobial, further dilution is needed.

blocks.zh: 溫度限制的原因：脂肪性產品處理時溫度限制在 40°C（特殊情況 45°C），是為了避免高溫殺死產品中原有的微生物，導致假陰性結果。
blocks.en: Why the temperature limit: when fatty products are handled, the temperature is limited to 40°C (45°C in exceptional cases) to avoid high temperatures killing the microorganisms originally present in the product, which would lead to false-negative results.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 Industry Application
blocks.en: Industry Application (CDMO)

blocks.zh: CDMO 經常處理的產品類型：
blocks.en: Product types a CDMO commonly handles:

blocks.zh: 注射液原料（水溶性）— 直接稀釋法，最簡單
blocks.en: Injectable raw materials (water-soluble): direct dilution method, the simplest

blocks.zh: 凍乾粉末（水溶性）— 溶解後稀釋，注意某些賦形劑可能有抑菌性
blocks.en: Lyophilized powders (water-soluble): dissolve, then dilute; note that some excipients may be antimicrobial

blocks.zh: 乳膏/軟膏基質（脂肪性）— 需要乳化處理，較耗時
blocks.en: Cream/ointment bases (fatty): emulsification is needed, which is more time-consuming

blocks.zh: 包裝材料（如橡膠塞）（不溶於水）— 浸泡振盪法萃取微生物
blocks.en: Packaging materials (e.g., rubber stoppers) (water-insoluble): immersion and shaking to extract microorganisms

blocks.zh: 一個含有凡士林基質的軟膏產品要做 USP 〈61〉 測試，你會如何準備樣品？為什麼不能直接用水性稀釋液？
blocks.en: An ointment product with a petrolatum base must be tested according to USP <61>. How would you prepare the sample? Why can you not simply use an aqueous diluent?

blocks.zh: 經皮貼片需要振盪至少 30 分鐘的目的是什麼？如果只振盪 5 分鐘，可能會有什麼後果？
blocks.en: What is the purpose of shaking a transdermal patch for at least 30 minutes? What could happen if it were shaken for only 5 minutes?

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 樣品前處理決策樹
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Sample Preparation Decision Tree

blocks.zh: 根據產品物理特性選擇方法：
blocks.en: Choose the method according to the physical properties of the product:

blocks.zh: 1.3 Neutralization/Removal of Antimicrobial Activity & Table 2 — 中和/去除抑菌活性
blocks.en: 1.3 Neutralization/Removal of Antimicrobial Activity & Table 2

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 中和策略四步驟
blocks.en: Key Concepts: The Four-Step Neutralization Strategy

blocks.zh: 遇到抑菌產品時的升級策略：
blocks.en: Escalation strategy for antimicrobial products:

blocks.zh: Step 1：加大稀釋 — 最簡單的方法，將產品稀釋到抑菌活性降低的濃度
blocks.en: Step 1: Increase the dilution - the simplest approach; dilute the product to a concentration at which the antimicrobial activity is reduced

blocks.zh: Step 2：加入中和劑 — 使用 Table 2 中的特定化學物質來中和抑菌成分
blocks.en: Step 2: Add a neutralizing agent - use the specific chemicals in Table 2 to neutralize the antimicrobial components

blocks.zh: Step 3：薄膜過濾法 — 將微生物截留在濾膜上，然後用大量稀釋液沖洗掉抑菌物質
blocks.en: Step 3: Membrane filtration - retain the microorganisms on the filter, then rinse away the antimicrobial substances with a large volume of diluent

blocks.zh: Step 4：組合策略 — 以上方法的組合
blocks.en: Step 4: Combination strategy - a combination of the above methods

blocks.zh: 原則是從最簡單的方法開始嘗試，逐步升級直到找到有效的中和方案。
blocks.en: The principle is to start with the simplest method and escalate step by step until an effective neutralization scheme is found.

blocks.zh: 解毒的概念：
blocks.en: The concept of detoxification:

blocks.zh: Table 2 就像一份「解毒對照表」。產品中的抑菌成分是「毒素」，會殺死或抑制微生物（讓你無法正確計數）。中和劑是「解藥」— 每種毒素有其對應的解藥：
blocks.en: Table 2 is like an "antidote chart". The antimicrobial components in a product are the "toxins" that kill or inhibit microorganisms (so you cannot count them correctly). The neutralizing agents are the "antidotes", and each toxin has its matching antidote:

blocks.zh: Parabens（防腐劑）被 Lecithin 中和 — 就像蛇毒被抗蛇毒血清中和
blocks.en: Parabens (preservatives) are neutralized by lecithin, like snake venom neutralized by antivenom

blocks.zh: QACs（消毒劑）被 Polysorbate 中和 — 界面活性劑包覆 QAC 分子使其失活
blocks.en: QACs (disinfectants) are neutralized by polysorbate: the surfactant envelops the QAC molecules and inactivates them

blocks.zh: 酒精被「稀釋」中和 — 最直覺的方法，稀釋到安全濃度
blocks.en: Alcohol is neutralized by dilution: the most intuitive method, dilute to a safe concentration

blocks.zh: 「Factor of 2」再次出現：USP 使用同樣的判斷標準 — 如果產品組的微生物回收量比對照組低超過 2 倍（即回收率 <50%），則認定存在抑菌活性，需要修改方法。
blocks.en: The "factor of 2" appears again: USP uses the same criterion. If the microbial recovery from the product is lower than the control by more than a factor of 2 (that is, recovery <50%), antimicrobial activity is considered present and the method must be modified.

blocks.zh: 找不到中和方法時的退路：如果所有方法都無法消除抑菌活性，USP 允許假設該產品對特定微生物具有殺菌能力，因此不太可能被該種微生物污染。但仍需使用最高可行稀釋度進行測試。
blocks.en: What to do if no neutralization method can be found: if no method can eliminate the antimicrobial activity, USP allows the assumption that the product is bactericidal against the given microorganism and is therefore unlikely to be contaminated by that species. Testing must still be performed at the highest practicable dilution.

blocks.zh: 實驗室常備「中和劑套裝」：大多數微生物實驗室會預先配製含有 lecithin + polysorbate 80 的通用中和稀釋液（如 Dey-Engley Neutralizing Broth），能中和大部分常見防腐劑。
blocks.en: A "neutralizer kit" kept in the lab: most microbiology laboratories prepare in advance a general-purpose neutralizing diluent containing lecithin + polysorbate 80 (such as Dey-Engley Neutralizing Broth), which neutralizes most common preservatives.

blocks.zh: 一個含有 0.02% benzalkonium chloride（BKC，四級銨鹽類消毒劑）的眼藥水需要做 USP 〈61〉 測試。根據 Table 2，你應該選用什麼中和劑？如果單獨使用該中和劑效果不夠，下一步怎麼做？
blocks.en: An eye drop containing 0.02% benzalkonium chloride (BKC, a quaternary ammonium disinfectant) must be tested according to USP <61>. According to Table 2, which neutralizing agent should you use? If that agent alone is not sufficient, what is the next step?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「稀釋法」同時出現在 Table 2 和中和策略的 Step 1？稀釋法的限制是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does the dilution method appear both in Table 2 and as Step 1 of the neutralization strategy? What are the limitations of dilution?

blocks.zh: 1.4 Recovery of Microorganisms in the Presence of Product — 產品存在下的微生物回收
blocks.en: 1.4 Recovery of Microorganisms in the Presence of Product

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 MPN 法的邏輯
blocks.en: Analogy: The Logic of the MPN Method

blocks.zh: 「猜猜罐子裡有幾顆糖」：
blocks.en: "Guess how many candies are in the jar":

blocks.zh: MPN 法的邏輯是間接推算的。想像你有一罐糖果，但你不能打開來數。你的方法是：
blocks.en: The logic of the MPN method is indirect estimation. Imagine a jar of candies that you cannot open to count. Your approach is:

blocks.zh: 倒出 1/10 到三個杯子 → 看哪些杯子有糖（有/無）
blocks.en: Pour out 1/10 into three cups and see which cups contain candy (yes/no)

blocks.zh: 再倒出 1/100 到三個杯子 → 看哪些杯子有糖
blocks.en: Pour out 1/100 into three cups and see which cups contain candy

blocks.zh: 再倒出 1/1000 到三個杯子 → 看哪些杯子有糖
blocks.en: Pour out 1/1000 into three cups and see which cups contain candy

blocks.zh: 根據「9 個杯子中，哪些有糖、哪些沒有」的組合，用統計表（Table 3）推算出罐子裡大約有幾顆糖。這是一種統計估算法，所以精確度自然不如「直接打開罐子來數」（薄膜過濾法或平板計數法）。
blocks.en: From the pattern of "which of the 9 cups have candy and which do not", a statistical table (Table 3) gives an estimate of roughly how many candies are in the jar. This is a statistical estimation method, so naturally it is less precise than "opening the jar and counting" (membrane filtration or plate-count methods).

blocks.zh: 薄膜過濾法的關鍵優勢 — 沖洗：將微生物截留在濾膜上後，可以用大量的沖洗液（rinse）來去除殘留的抑菌物質。這是它在抑菌性產品測試中被優先推薦的核心原因。
blocks.en: The key advantage of membrane filtration is rinsing: after the microorganisms are retained on the filter, a large volume of rinse fluid can be used to remove residual antimicrobial substances. This is the main reason it is the preferred method for testing antimicrobial products.

blocks.zh: 傾注法 vs 塗佈法：
blocks.en: Pour-plate vs surface-spread:

blocks.zh: Pour-plate（傾注法）：樣品先加入培養皿，再倒入 45°C 的瓊脂。微生物分散在培養基內部生長。適合大多數產品。
blocks.en: Pour-plate: the sample is first added to the Petri dish, and then agar at 45°C is poured in. The microorganisms grow within the medium. Suitable for most products.

blocks.zh: Surface-spread（塗佈法）：先倒培養基讓其凝固，再將樣品塗在表面。微生物在培養基表面生長。適合需要觀察菌落形態的場景。
blocks.en: Surface-spread: the medium is poured first and allowed to solidify, and then the sample is spread on the surface. The microorganisms grow on the surface of the medium. Suitable when colony morphology needs to be observed.

blocks.zh: 0.45 µm 而非 0.2 µm：注意微生物計數用的濾膜孔徑要求是 ≤0.45 µm，不同於無菌過濾用的 0.2 µm。這是因為 0.45 µm 已足夠截留所有細菌和黴菌。
blocks.en: 0.45 µm, not 0.2 µm: note that the filter pore size required for microbial enumeration is ≤0.45 µm, which differs from the 0.2 µm used for sterilizing filtration. A 0.45 µm filter is sufficient to retain all bacteria and molds.

blocks.zh: 為什麼平板計數法要求「至少做兩份」（in duplicate），而薄膜過濾法只需要每菌一片濾膜？
blocks.en: Why do plate-count methods require testing "in duplicate", while membrane filtration needs only one filter per microorganism?

blocks.zh: 傾注法要求培養基溫度不超過 45°C。如果溫度過高（如 55°C），會發生什麼？如果溫度太低（如 35°C），又會怎樣？
blocks.en: The pour-plate method requires the medium temperature not to exceed 45°C. What happens if the temperature is too high (e.g., 55°C)? What if it is too low (e.g., 35°C)?

blocks.zh: 在什麼情況下，你會不得不選擇 MPN 法而非薄膜過濾法或平板計數法？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances would you have to choose the MPN method rather than membrane filtration or a plate-count method?

blocks.zh: 1.5 Table 3: Most-Probable-Number (MPN) Values — 最可能數值表
blocks.en: 1.5 Table 3: Most-Probable-Number (MPN) Values

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 如何讀 MPN 表
blocks.en: Key Concepts: How to Read the MPN Table

blocks.zh: 讀表步驟：
blocks.en: Steps for reading the table:

blocks.zh: 記錄三個稀釋度（0.1 g/mL、0.01 g/mL、0.001 g/mL）中每組 3 管有生長的管數
blocks.en: Record the number of tubes showing growth (out of 3) at each of the three dilutions (0.1 g/mL, 0.01 g/mL, 0.001 g/mL)

blocks.zh: 得到三個數字的組合（如 2-1-0）
blocks.en: This gives a combination of three numbers (e.g., 2-1-0)

blocks.zh: 在 Table 3 中找到對應的 MPN 值和 95% 信賴區間
blocks.en: Find the corresponding MPN value and 95% confidence interval in Table 3

blocks.zh: 範例：組合 2-1-0 表示 — 0.1 g/mL 的三管中有 2 管長菌，0.01 g/mL 有 1 管長菌，0.001 g/mL 有 0 管長菌。查表得 MPN = 15 cfu/g（95% CI: 4–38）。
blocks.en: Example: the combination 2-1-0 means 2 of the 3 tubes at 0.1 g/mL show growth, 1 at 0.01 g/mL shows growth, and 0 at 0.001 g/mL show growth. The table gives MPN = 15 cfu/g (95% CI: 4–38).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 為什麼 MPN 不精確
blocks.en: Analogy: Why the MPN Is Imprecise

blocks.zh: 擲骰子估算人數：
blocks.en: Estimating headcount by rolling dice:

blocks.zh: 注意 95% 信賴區間的寬度 — 很多組合的上下限相差 10 倍甚至更多。例如組合 3-0-2 的 MPN 是 64，但 95% CI 是 16–181，跨越了超過一個 log。這就像用擲骰子來估算教室裡有多少人 — 你能給出一個大致範圍，但精確度遠不如直接點人頭。
blocks.en: Note the width of the 95% confidence interval: for many combinations the upper and lower limits differ by a factor of 10 or more. For example, the combination 3-0-2 has an MPN of 64, but the 95% CI is 16–181, spanning more than one log. It is like estimating how many people are in a classroom by rolling dice: you can give a rough range, but the precision is far below that of counting heads directly.

blocks.zh: 這也是為什麼 MPN 法只在其他方法都不可行時才使用。
blocks.en: This is also why the MPN method is used only when no other method is feasible.

blocks.zh: 組合 0-0-0 的意義：當九管全部無生長時，結果報告為 <3 cfu/g（或 /mL）。注意不是報告為「0」— 因為統計上無法證明完全沒有微生物，只能說低於偵測極限。
blocks.en: The meaning of the combination 0-0-0: when none of the nine tubes shows growth, the result is reported as <3 cfu/g (or /mL). Note that it is not reported as "0", because statistically the complete absence of microorganisms cannot be proven; one can only say it is below the detection limit.

blocks.zh: 組合 3-3-3 的意義：九管全部有生長時，報告 >1100 cfu/g。這代表 bioburden 超出了該稀釋方案的測量範圍，需要進一步稀釋後重新測試。
blocks.en: The meaning of the combination 3-3-3: when all nine tubes show growth, the result is reported as >1100 cfu/g. This means the bioburden exceeds the measuring range of this dilution scheme, and the test must be repeated at higher dilutions.

blocks.zh: 計算範例 MPN Calculation Example
blocks.en: Calculation Example: MPN

blocks.zh:
場景：測試一批賦形劑的 TAMC
稀釋方案：0.1 g/mL、0.01 g/mL、0.001 g/mL
每個稀釋度各 3 管

結果：
  0.1 g/mL: 3 管中 1 管有生長
  0.01 g/mL: 3 管中 1 管有生長
  0.001 g/mL: 3 管中 0 管有生長

組合 = 1-1-0
查 Table 3 → MPN = 7.4 cfu/g
95% CI = 1.3–20

報告：TAMC = 7.4 cfu/g (MPN method)
blocks.en:
Scenario: TAMC test of a batch of excipient
Dilution scheme: 0.1 g/mL, 0.01 g/mL, 0.001 g/mL
3 tubes per dilution

Results:
  0.1 g/mL: 1 of 3 tubes with growth
  0.01 g/mL: 1 of 3 tubes with growth
  0.001 g/mL: 0 of 3 tubes with growth

Combination = 1-1-0
Table 3 → MPN = 7.4 cfu/g
95% CI = 1.3–20

Report: TAMC = 7.4 cfu/g (MPN method)

blocks.zh: MPN 測試結果為組合 2-2-1。查 Table 3 後，TAMC 結果是多少？如果該產品的接受標準是 10<sup>2</sup> cfu/g（最大可接受 200），該產品合格嗎？
blocks.en: An MPN test gives the combination 2-2-1. What is the TAMC result from Table 3? If the acceptance criterion for the product is 10<sup>2</sup> cfu/g (maximum acceptable count 200), does the product pass?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 MPN 表中某些不同的組合會給出相同的 MPN 值（例如 1-0-1 和 1-1-0 都接近 7）？這反映了什麼統計原理？
blocks.en: Why do some different combinations in the MPN table give the same MPN value (e.g., 1-0-1 and 1-1-0 are both close to 7)? What statistical principle does this reflect?

blocks.zh: 1.6 Results and Interpretation of Suitability Testing — 適用性測試的結果與判讀
blocks.en: 1.6 Results and Interpretation of Suitability Testing

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 合格判斷標準
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 兩套不同的判斷標準：
blocks.en: Two different sets of criteria:

blocks.zh: 薄膜過濾法/平板計數法：產品組的回收計數與對照組的比較不超過 2 倍差異（Factor of 2 rule）。即回收率 50–200%。
blocks.en: Membrane filtration/plate-count methods: the recovery count for the product must not differ from that of the control by more than a factor of 2 (the factor of 2 rule), that is, recovery of 50–200%.

blocks.zh: MPN 法：產品組的 MPN 值必須落在對照組結果的 95% 信賴區間內。由於 MPN 法本身精確度較低，所以用較寬鬆的統計標準。
blocks.en: MPN method: the MPN value for the product must fall within the 95% confidence interval of the control result. Because the MPN method is inherently less precise, a wider statistical criterion is used.

blocks.zh: 「最佳努力」原則：
blocks.en: The "best effort" principle:

blocks.zh: 最後一段是 USP 的「安全網」— 如果你嘗試了所有可用的方法，但沒有任何一種能完全符合 factor of 2 的標準，你不需要放棄。而是選擇「最接近」標準的方法。這就像考試找不到完美答案時，選擇「最佳選項」。這體現了 USP 的務實精神 — 有測試數據總比沒有好。
blocks.en: The last paragraph is USP's "safety net": if you have tried all available methods and none fully meets the factor of 2 criterion, you do not need to give up. Instead, choose the method that comes "closest" to the criterion. It is like an exam where no perfect answer can be found, so you choose the "best option". This reflects USP's pragmatism: having test data is better than having none.

blocks.zh: 方法適用性 vs 方法驗證：USP 〈61〉 要求的是「方法適用性」（method suitability），不是完整的「方法驗證」（method validation）。適用性測試是確認藥典方法在你的特定產品上能正常運作；方法驗證則是對全新方法進行完整的性能確認。前者要求較簡單，後者更全面。
blocks.en: Method suitability vs method validation: USP <61> requires "method suitability", not full "method validation". Suitability testing confirms that the compendial method works properly on your specific product; method validation is the full performance confirmation of a brand-new method. The former is less demanding, the latter more comprehensive.

blocks.zh: 方法適用性測試中，S. aureus 的回收率為 45%（低於 50%），但 P. aeruginosa 的回收率為 85%。整體適用性測試算通過嗎？你的下一步行動是什麼？
blocks.en: In the method suitability test, the recovery of S. aureus is 45% (below 50%), but the recovery of P. aeruginosa is 85%. Does the suitability test pass overall? What is your next step?

blocks.zh: 如果你使用了稀釋法、中和劑、薄膜過濾法的組合，但 B. subtilis 的回收率仍然只有 35%，根據 USP 的「最佳努力」原則，你可以怎麼做？
blocks.en: If you have used a combination of dilution, neutralizing agent and membrane filtration, but the recovery of B. subtilis is still only 35%, what can you do under USP's "best effort" principle?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Table 1 定義了五種標準測試微生物：涵蓋 G(+)、G(-)、孢子形成菌、酵母菌、黴菌，各有指定的培養基與培養條件
blocks.en: Table 1 defines five standard test microorganisms: covering Gram-positive bacteria, Gram-negative bacteria, spore formers, yeasts and molds, each with specified media and incubation conditions

blocks.zh: Factor of 2 Rule 是核心判斷標準 — 生長促進和方法適用性都使用此規則（回收率 50–200%）
blocks.en: The factor of 2 rule is the core criterion: both growth promotion and method suitability use this rule (recovery of 50–200%)

blocks.zh: 樣品前處理需根據產品物理特性選擇適當方法，1:10 稀釋是預設起點
blocks.en: Sample preparation must be chosen according to the physical properties of the product; a 1:10 dilution is the default starting point

blocks.zh: Table 2 提供中和劑指南 — 配對干擾物質與對應的化學中和劑
blocks.en: Table 2 provides guidance on neutralizing agents: it pairs interfering substances with the corresponding chemical neutralizers

blocks.zh: 三種回收方法各有適用場景：薄膜過濾法（可沖洗、首選）、平板計數法（簡單、需複數平板）、MPN 法（統計估算、僅限 TAMC）
blocks.en: The three recovery methods each have their own applications: membrane filtration (allows rinsing, the first choice), plate-count methods (simple, require duplicate plates), MPN method (statistical estimation, TAMC only)

blocks.zh: Table 3 (MPN 值表) 提供三管三稀釋度的所有可能組合對應的微生物數量估算
blocks.en: Table 3 (MPN values) gives the estimated microbial count for every possible combination of the three-tube, three-dilution scheme

blocks.zh: 「最佳努力」原則 — 如果所有方法都不完全符合標準，使用最接近的方法
blocks.en: The "best effort" principle: if no method fully meets the criteria, use the method that comes closest
